authoritative_tasks_supported.title: Job Parsing
authoritative_tasks_supported.fallback_policy: Use normalized fields supplied by job-source parsers; do not invent missing fields.

authoritative_tasks_supported.title: Job Scoring
authoritative_tasks_supported.fallback_policy: Rule-based, explainable match scores and filters remain available.

authoritative_tasks_supported.title: Requirement Extraction
authoritative_tasks_supported.fallback_policy: Use explicit posting requirements; keep unrecognized qualifications unknown.

authoritative_tasks_supported.title: Resume Tailoring
authoritative_tasks_supported.fallback_policy: Select and reorder approved career facts with safe templates; do not add or rephrase claims.

authoritative_tasks_supported.title: Cover Letters
authoritative_tasks_supported.fallback_policy: Build a factual cover letter from the approved profile and job fields.

authoritative_tasks_supported.title: Free-form Answers
authoritative_tasks_supported.fallback_policy: No new answer is generated; review and reuse only explicitly approved saved answers.

authoritative_tasks_supported.title: Company Summarization
authoritative_tasks_supported.fallback_policy: No company summary is generated; source-grounded company facts remain available.

safety_invariants.secret_leak_prevention: Model identifiers with credential prefixes (sk-, ghp_, gho_, hf_) are rejected safely without echoing inputs.
safety_invariants.model_id_validation: Model ID is required whenever provider is not disabled.
safety_invariants.loopback_and_budget_controls: All local inference routes strictly honor loopback constraints without environment proxy leaks.
